## Problem

No \`"component":"..."\` line from a pino child logger reaches the local clone's log files. Found by the #384 lane while proving the maintenance sweep producer live: \`maintenance_sweep_complete\` (child logger, \`component: "maintenance"\`) never appears in the clone logs, while module-logger lines (\`graph_derivation_enqueue_sweep\`) do.

## Why it matters

- Pre-existing routing quirk of the server path — not introduced by PR #609; durable \`maintenance_jobs\` rows prove the producer runs regardless.
- The same unrouted stream would carry the sweep's warn-level **bound-reached** lines that #384's acceptance criteria require, so this defect blocks the final criterion of #384.

## Evidence

- PR #609 self-review: "no \`"component":"..."\` line does [reach the clone's log files]".
- Reproduce: trigger a sweep on the local clone (\`server/main.ts\` entrypoint), compare child-logger vs module-logger emissions against the clone log files.

## Done means

An executable check (scripts/done-means/) that greps the clone log file for a child-logger line with a \`component\` field emitted during the run, red on current behavior.

Blocks: #384 (final logging criterion).
